clips.caption:
A lot of spiritual people say wanting more for yourself is selfish. You should be out there fixing the world.

Kevin Trudeau's answer: you cannot push a rope. Work on yourself first.

Your eyes are projectors, not cameras. When you get better, the world you see and the world you create get better with you.

Who is the one person you keep trying to fix instead of yourself?

#kevintrudeau #selfimprovement #mindset #manifestation #personalgrowth #successmindset

clips.end_words: life I want for my next chapter
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau spent 10 years in federal prison. He calls it a gift.

One day the warden stopped him and said: in 35 years I have seen tens of thousands of inmates, and you are the only one who is actually happy to be here.

His answer: I can't control that I'm here. I can control how I feel. So he did yoga, learned German and Italian, read great books, and walked out to a blank canvas.

What would you do with a clean slate?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #resilience #attitude #comeback #successmindset
